items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Terminology 23:1
items.html: There is no renewal of illumination in the worlds except from Ein Sof, as is known. And when some degree is renewed in the worlds, although it emerges from the upper one adjacent to it, that upper one nevertheless receives it by way of all the preceding degrees up to Ein Sof. Therefore every Partzuf receives two kinds of illumination from its upper one: namely, for the need of its own structure, and for the need of the structure of the degree below it. Now what the Partzuf receives from its upper one for the need of its own structure is called the first Hassadim and Gevurot; and what it receives for the need of the structure of the degree below it is called the new Hassadim and Gevurot. (p. 647, Item 51)
